title: Gaze-Aware AI: Mathematical modeling of epistemic experience of the Marginalized for Human-Computer Interaction & AI Systems

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring epistemic divergence and 'gaze pressure' by applying zero-shot classification of 28 linguistic coping behaviors (e.g., hedging, over-apologizing) to Reddit comments from the LGBTQ+ community (r/ainbow).

Calculating a Gaze Pressure Index Difference (GPI-Diff) by comparing the linguistic coping markers, variance structures, and emotional effort of a right-wing political subreddit (r/conservative) against a marginalized community subreddit.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
